blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-resolution video generation is expensive, as its cost grows rapidly with the number of spatiotemporal tokens. A practical alternative first generates a lower-resolution video and then applies a refiner, but conventional multi-step refinement introduces a second sampling bottleneck. We present SoL-Refiner , a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution model outputs into 4K videos with a single denoising step. Our three-stage recipe combines high-resolution continual training, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, and a final one-step distillation. We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at × 2176 3840\!\times\!2176 it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generation has advanced toward higher visual fidelity and output resolution, but at substantial inference cost [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Larger models increase the cost of each denoising step [ 5 , 6 ] , while higher resolutions lengthen the spatiotemporal token sequence and raise the cost of every step.
Smaller models and lower-resolution sampling reduce this burden [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , but can compromise fine texture and local detail [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
视频的制作已经向更高的视觉忠诚度和输出分辨率迈进,但以相当大的推论成本[2,3,4,5]. 较大的模型会增加每个去诺音步骤[5,6]的成本,而更高的分辨率会延长spatiental符号序列,提高每个步骤的成本.
较小的模型和分辨率较低的采样可以减轻这种负担[7,8,9],但可以损害精细的纹理和当地细节[4].

blocks.en:
A two-stage design addresses this trade-off by separating low-resolution content generation from high-resolution detail refinement [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
The base model establishes motion, composition, and scene content at low resolution, while the refiner enhances textures and local details at the target resolution.
The base stage can also use more aggressive acceleration, and the refiner repairs the resulting artifacts.
Existing refiners, however, often require multiple target-resolution denoising steps, creating a second sampling bottleneck [ 13 , 10 ] .
Many refiners are also developed for a particular base generator, and their transfer to outputs from other generators is rarely evaluated.
blocks.zh:
一个两阶段的设计通过将低分辨率内容生成与高分辨率细节的完善区分开来解决这种权衡[10,11,12].
基模型以低分辨率确定运动,组成和场景内容,而精炼器则在目标分辨率上增强纹理和局部细节.
基级还可以使用更积极的加速度,精细器对由此而来的文物进行修复.
然而,现有的精炼厂往往需要多个目标分辨率解析步骤,从而产生第二个取样瓶颈[13,10].
许多精炼机也是为特定的基发电机开发的,它们转移到其他发电机的产出上很少被评价.

blocks.en:
We introduce SoL-Refiner, a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution inputs into high-resolution videos with improved local detail ( Figures 1(a) and 1(c) ).
It can refine outputs from different base generators without modifying or retraining the base models.
Starting from a pretrained LTX-2.3 checkpoint, training follows three stages: high-resolution continual training on paired videos, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training with frame-based reward models, and one-step distillation. We further reduce encoding, decoding, and denoising latency with a tiny autoencoder (TAE) [ 14 ] and Sol-Engine [ 15 ] .
Within the refinement stage alone, the complete acceleration stack achieves an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner in our 2K latency setting. Paired with a four-step MiniMax H3 base model, the full two-stage pipeline is 27 × 27\times faster than direct full-resolution H3 generation ( Figure 1(b) ).
blocks.zh:
我们介绍SOL-Refiner, 即一个单步视频精炼器,
它可以在不修改或再培训基准模型的情况下,改进不同基发电机的输出。
从一个经过预先训练的LTX-2.3检查站开始,培训分为三个阶段:对配对视频进行高分辨率的持续培训、采用帧奖励模式的强化学习(RL)后培训,以及一步一步的蒸馏。 我们进一步减少编码,解码,用一个微小的自动编码器(TAE)[14]和Sol-Engine[15]去除时空.
仅在完善阶段内,完整的加速度堆栈就实现了8.91×8.91\时的提速,在我们2K潜伏的设定中超过了LTX-2.3的三步炼油机. 具有四步MiniMax H3基型的Paired,全双级管道比直接全分辨率H3生成快27×27\时(图1(b)).

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce SoL-Refiner, a video refiner that upsamples and refines low-resolution outputs from multiple base generators in a single denoising step. • We develop a three-stage training recipe that establishes high-resolution refinement through continual training, improves perceptual quality through RL post-training with frame-based rewards, and distills the resulting multi-step refiner into a one-step model. • We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners. At 2K resolution, SoL-Refiner outperforms the evaluated external refiners on average VBench and UniPercept scores, and improves over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner from 720p to 4K.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: SoL-Refiner targets synthesis artifacts in AI-generated videos, including distorted local structures and inconsistent textures. Resolution enlargement is optional: refinement can improve a generated video at its existing resolution or accompany upsampling ( Figures 1(a) and 1(c) ). Prior work also addresses generated video quality. VEnhancer combines spatial and temporal super-resolution with video enhancement [ 16 ] . Ultra Flash trains on degradations tailored to generated videos and combines reward-enhanced one-step distillation with cascaded streaming preference optimization [ 17 ] . Its design centers on high-resolution streaming generation. Our focus is the refinement of generator outputs, including artifact correction without spatial enlargement, and we assess transfer across base generators.
blocks.zh: SoL-Refiner瞄准AI生成的视频中的合成文物,包括扭曲的局部结构和不一致的纹理. 扩大分辨率是可选的:改进后可以改进现有分辨率生成的视频,或同时进行取样(图1(a)和1(c))。 以前的工作还产生了视频质量。 VEnhancer将空间和时间超分辨率与视频增强结合[16]. 超强 针对生成的视频定制的降解的闪电列车,结合奖励强化的单步蒸馏与级联流式偏好优化[17]. 其设计以高分辨率流线发电为中心. 我们的重点是改进发电机的产出,包括不扩大空间的文物校正,我们评估各基地发电机之间的转移。

blocks.en: Cascaded generators use a low-resolution stage for content and motion, followed by high-resolution processing. Imagen Video interleaves spatial and temporal super-resolution models [ 2 ] ; FlashVideo learns a few-step flow-matching detail model [ 4 ] ; and LUVE combines latent upsampling with high-resolution experts [ 18 ] . The released LTX-2.3 and LingBot-Video pipelines use three-step and eight-step refiners, respectively [ 10 , 13 , 19 ] . SoL-Refiner can serve as the refinement stage in such a cascade, using one denoising step to improve the base video. We evaluate released refiners on shared inputs from multiple generators to separate their refinement performance from the choice of upstream generator.
blocks.zh: cascadd发电机在内容和运动上使用低分辨率级,然后进行高分辨率处理. Imagen Video互换空间和时间超分辨率模型[2];FlashVideo学习几步流比细节模型[4];以及LUVE将潜在的提升样本与高分辨率专家结合[18]. 已释放的LTX-2.3和LingBot-Video输油管分别使用三步式和八步式精炼机[10,13,19]. SoL-Refiner可以作为这种级联的完善阶段,使用一个调试步骤来改进基础视频. 我们评价多台发电机共享投入的释放精炼器,以区分其精炼性能与上游发电机的选择.

blocks.en: Diffusion-based restoration provides relevant priors and training methods for refinement. Upscale-A-Video uses recurrent latent propagation for temporally consistent upscaling [ 20 ] , and SeedVR supports variable video lengths and resolutions through shifted-window attention [ 21 ] . One-step methods reduce repeated denoising: DOVE uses staged latent-pixel training [ 22 ] , UltraVSR uses a degradation-aware schedule and distillation [ 23 ] , and SeedVR2 uses adversarial post-training [ 24 ] . FlashVSR combines one-step distillation with causal sparse attention and a lightweight decoder [ 25 ] . We include SeedVR2 as a one-step restoration baseline in our evaluation. Our task concerns defects introduced during video synthesis; recovering spatial resolution is one application of the refiner, rather than its defining objective.
blocks.zh: 基于传播的修复为完善提供了相关的前科和培训方法. Upscale-A-Video利用反复出现的潜在传播来进行时间上一致的提升[20],种子VR通过转向窗口关注支持可变视频长度和分辨率[21]. 单步法减少重复的去诺:DOVE使用级潜在像素训练[22],UltraVSR使用降解意识表和蒸馏[23],SeedVR2使用对抗性后训练[24]. FlashVSR将单步蒸馏与因果稀疏的注意力和轻量级解码器结合[25]. 我们评价中将种子VR2作为一步恢复基线。 我们的任务涉及视频合成过程中引入的缺陷;恢复空间分辨率是精炼剂的一种应用,而不是其定义目标.

blocks.en: Our training builds on distribution matching and reward-based post-training. DMD2 combines teacher distribution matching with adversarial supervision [ 26 ] , SF-V uses adversarial training for single-forward video generation [ 27 ] , and ImageReward introduces Reward Feedback Learning [ 28 ] . In Ultra Flash, perceptual rewards directly supervise the student during one-step distillation [ 17 ] . We instead apply frame-based rewards to the multi-step refiner before distilling it through a few-step intermediate student. Distillation combines the teacher’s distribution supervision with implicit distribution alignment [ 29 ] and a projected DiT discriminator, drawing on projected adversarial supervision in PiD [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的培训建立在分配匹配和奖励的基础上。 DMD2将师资配送与对抗式监督相匹配[26],SF-V对单向视频生成采用对抗式训练[27],图像奖励引入奖励反馈学习[28]. 在Ultra Flash中,知觉奖励在一步蒸馏过程中直接监督学生[17]. 相反,我们把基于帧的奖励应用于多步骤精炼厂,然后通过几个步骤的中学生来提炼。 抖音结合了教师的配送监督与隐含配送对调[29]和一个预测的DiT歧视者,借鉴了PiD[30]中预计的对抗监督.

blocks.en: 4.4 Inference Optimization
blocks.zh: 4.4 推论优化

blocks.en: We accelerate refinement with Sol-Engine [ 15 ] , which combines kernel fusion with sparse attention based on Sol-Attn [ 36 ] to reduce denoising computation. A tiny autoencoder (TAE) [ 14 ] replaces the full VAE to reduce video encoding and decoding latency. For multi-step refinement, Sol-Engine additionally reuses cached intermediate results across denoising steps. Figure 6 reports the latency gains for the multi-step refiner and the one-step pipeline.

blocks.en: We evaluate SoL-Refiner on Refiner-Bench, which contains 150 videos. Section 5.1 compares it with existing models across metrics and resolutions and evaluates acceleration across base generators. blocks.en: We compare SoL-Refiner with LingBot Stage-2 Refiner [ 13 , 19 ] , LTX-2.3 Refiner [ 10 ] , LTX-2.0 Refiner [ 10 ] , and SEEDVR2 [ 24 ] on Refiner-Bench. All 150 aligned videos are resized to × 576 1024\!\times\!576 . Outputs are × 1088 1920\!\times\!1088 for LingBot and × 1152 2048\!\times\!1152 for the other refiners. VBench [ 37 ] averages subject consistency (SC), background consistency (BC), motion smoothness (MS), dynamic degree (DD), aesthetic quality (AQ), and imaging quality (IQ), while UniPercept [ 38 ] averages IAA, IQA, and ISTA. With one refinement step, SoL-Refiner outperforms all evaluated external refiners on VBench AQ, IQ, and AVG and UniPercept AVG, including SEEDVR2 under the same step budget ( Tables 1 and 2 ). Its VBench and UniPercept averages are 0.81048 and 60.4150, respectively. Our 23-step variant achieves higher scores on these metrics.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: SoL-Refiner makes high-resolution video generation more efficient by moving most denoising computation to a lower-resolution base generator and reserving one target-resolution step for refinement. Continual training learns the low-to-high-quality mapping, reward feedback learning improves perceptual quality, and staged DMD-GAN distillation with a projected DiT discriminator compresses refinement to one step. On Refiner-Bench, the one-step model outperforms external refiners in average VBench and UniPercept scores. In our 2K latency setting, the one-step refiner with TAE and Sol-Engine reduces refinement latency from 57.461 to 6.447 seconds, an 8.91 × 8.91\times speedup over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner.
blocks.zh: SoL-Refiner使高分辨率视频生成效率更高,方法是将大多数调试计算移到低分辨率基生成器上,并保留一个目标分辨率步骤以供完善. 持续培训学习低质量到高品质的绘图,奖励反馈学习提高了知觉质量,并用预计的DiT歧视者压缩器进行DMD-GAN蒸馏,精炼到一步. 在Refineer-Bench上,单步模型在平均V Bench和UniPercept的分数中超越了外部精炼器. 在我们2K潜伏的设定中,配有TAE和Sol-Engine的单步提炼机将提炼潜伏速度从57.461秒降低到6.447秒,比三步LTX-2.3提炼机的8.91×8.91\提速.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: On Refiner-Bench, the 23-step model achieves higher VBench and UniPercept averages than the one-step model. Our refinement objective targets local visual detail while preserving the base video’s content and motion. Correcting large semantic, geometric, or motion errors is not an explicit training objective. Stage II evaluates three sampled frames per video using image-quality and preference reward models. These frame-based rewards do not directly measure long-range temporal consistency. Refiner-Bench covers AI-generated videos from several base generators; camera-captured degradations and broader video editing tasks remain outside this study.
blocks.zh: 在炼油-奔驰上,23步模型实现了比单步模型更高的V奔驰和UniPercept平均值. 我们的完善目标针对当地视觉细节, 纠正大语义、几何或运动错误并不是明确的训练目标。 第二阶段采用图像质量和偏好奖励模式,对每部视频的三个抽样帧进行评价。 这些基于框架的奖励并不直接衡量长期时间一致性。 炼油机-Bench覆盖了来自几个基厂发电机的AI生成的视频;相机捕获的降解和更广泛的视频编辑任务仍然在本研究之外.
